summary: Security audit #2 fixes verified (backend only). New suite tests/test_signature_xss_csp_iter41.py: 22/23 pass. Signature SIG_RE validation now applies to every stop (non-pharmacy, pharmacy, admin too). Payloads like 'M0 0" onmouseover="alert(1)', '<script>', 'hello', 'L10 10' and 'M0 0 e5' return 400 'The signature must be drawn on the signature pad' and the stop stays pending. Valid 'M10.5 20 L30 40.2 M5 5 L6 6' and SignaturePad-style 'M12.0 34.0 L...' (including negative coordinates) deliver with 200. On the proof page, a legacy malicious signature written straight into the DB (plaintext and Fernet-encrypted) stays inside the d attribute (" ' < escaped). The CSP header has default-src 'none' and no script-src, and the expired 410 page has it too. Labels autoprint: the CSP script-src sha256 matches the inline window.onload script. Without autoprint there is no app script and the CSP is still present. A forged route name is escaped. Report CSV with a forged X-Forwarded-Host or Host of evil.com (public URL, and directly on :8001): proof_link always uses https://arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com and public_base is unchanged. Regression (serial, reset before each batch): security_audit_fixes + photo_hijack_iter40 + rx_handoff (41/41), badges_share_trends_apology + codes_coaching_expiry (34/34), auth_merchant_report 16/16 after fixing outdated test data. One spec mismatch: the signature length cap is 50000, not 200000.

minor.issue: Signature length cap is 50000 chars (routes/stops.py:193), but the review spec says <=200000. A valid 100004-char drawn path is rejected with 400. At about 12 chars per point, 50000 is roughly 4100 points (about 70 s of continuous drawing), so real users are unlikely to hit it. Align the code or the spec.

The global HTML CSP middleware also applies to the FastAPI Swagger UI, which loads CDN JS and so would be blocked. It is not publicly routed (only /api goes to the backend), so impact is internal only.

action_items: Decide on the signature max length: either raise the cap in routes/stops.py:193 to 200000 to match the spec, or keep 50000 and update the spec. tests/test_signature_xss_csp_iter41.py::test_long_valid_under_200k_accepted_spec encodes the 200000 spec.
Optional: skip the HTML_CSP middleware for /docs and /redoc, or disable them in production.
critical_code_review_comments: The escaping (xml_escape with the " and ' entities) is correct for attribute context in feedback.py:292 and scorecards.py:192.
The proof page photo uses a same-origin /api/files/... URL that returns bytes, so img-src 'self' does not break photos.
The Cloudflare edge injects a challenge <script> into HTML responses. The strict CSP blocks it, which is harmless, but tests must ignore it (strip_cf helper).
Legacy tests used arbitrary signature strings (data:image/png..., TEST_sig). These are now rejected by design, so the test data was updated to valid SVG paths.
updated_files: Test data only (signature literals changed to 'M10 10 L20 20 L30 15'): tests/test_auth_merchant_report.py, backend_test.py, test_digest_reorder_nearby_merchant.py, test_driver_login_merchant_alerts.py, test_first_delivery_email.py, test_future_days_summary_labels.py, test_invoices_hst.py, test_pickup_run_geofence.py, test_pricing_billing.py, test_privacy_compliance.py, seed_ui_iter27.py
